channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 retires from the Claude API on November 30 — migrate to Sonnet 5.5
item.description: Claude Sonnet 4.5 stops working on the Claude API on November 30 — Anthropic says to switch to Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 4.8 fast mode goes the same day.

item.title: Codex 0.167.0 ships an Agent Command Center for managing agent sessions
item.description: Codex 0.167.0 adds an Agent Command Center to manage coding-agent sessions, with backend switching and local image previews.

item.title: Compass says AI home-search agents favor its listings and bypass portals
item.description: Compass says AI agents like Instinct and Muse are going straight to brokerage sites for home searches, bypassing traditional listing portals.

item.title: Lumière PayCheck paid 45,152 x402 endpoints — 95% delivered once paid, but half of payment attempts never completed
item.description: A six-week test paid 45,152 x402 endpoints: 95% delivered once paid, but half of all payment attempts never completed — the payment itself is the weak link.

item.title: Phonic raises $27.5M Series A to help voice agents understand callers
item.description: Phonic raised $27.5M to build speech-to-speech AI models that help voice agents understand callers better.

item.title: ShareGate MCP brings Microsoft 365 governance into Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot
item.description: ShareGate launched an MCP connector that lets Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot govern Microsoft 365 under the permissions users already have.

item.title: Base44 scales from $3.5M to $200M ARR after Wix’s $80M acquisition
item.description: Base44 grew from $3.5M to a $200M revenue run-rate with about 2 million users in the year since Wix bought it for $80M.

item.title: Anthropic presses ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO, targeting $80-100B at a $1.25-1.75T valuation
item.description: Anthropic is pressing ahead with a pre-Thanksgiving IPO, aiming to raise $80-100 billion at a $1.25-1.75 trillion valuation despite the recent tech selloff.

item.title: Axon invests another $1.2B in Skydio at a $5.2B valuation and takes exclusive public-safety distribution
item.description: Axon is investing another $1.2 billion in drone maker Skydio at a $5.2 billion valuation and becoming its exclusive public-safety distributor in the US and Canada.

item.title: DigitalOcean launches Cuttlefish, an iPhone app to approve or block AI agent actions, plus a Box integration for agents on shared files
item.description: DigitalOcean launched Cuttlefish, an iPhone app that lets you approve or block individual AI agent actions, plus a Box integration so agents work on shared files in place.

item.description: Shield AI raises $2.5B and buys radar maker Echodyne in a $5.3B deal

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab closing in on a $5B round at a $40B valuation
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab is reportedly closing a $5 billion funding round at a $40 billion valuation, led by Accel.

item.title: Future Secure AI raises $80M in convertible notes at a reported $1.2B valuation cap
item.description: Future Secure AI raised $80 million for supervised AI agent teams that handle work in banking, consulting, healthcare and law.

item.title: AMD open-sources PrimusClaw, a managed agent runtime for its Instinct GPU clusters
item.description: AMD open-sourced PrimusClaw, a managed runtime for AI agents that runs on its Instinct GPU clusters with per-session sandboxes.

item.title: NVIDIA opens four Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for robot and self-driving simulation
item.description: NVIDIA released four open Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for robot and self-driving simulation, with the full training recipe included.

item.title: x402 settles 197.6M payments worth $42.5M in stablecoins
item.description: A live tracker counts over 197.5 million x402 payments settled and $42.5 million in volume as of November 7, with Base the largest chain.

item.description: Meta launched Spaces in Muse: describe an idea in chat and Muse builds a persistent custom experience like a tracker, planner, or project board in the sidebar.

item.title: firmly raises $15M Series A and launches Ask Agent in-chat checkout
item.description: firmly raised a $15M Series A and launched Ask Agent, letting shoppers discover products and check out inside a chat on merchant websites.

item.title: Cowboy raises $5M seed to launch an app store for AI agents
item.description: Cowboy raised a $5M seed round to launch an app store for AI agents, opening with more than 100 agents and 10,000 data feeds.

item.title: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude (US beta) — read-only bank linking via Plaid
item.description: Anthropic launched Personal Finance in Claude in US beta: link bank and card accounts via Plaid and ask Claude about your money — read-only, it can't move funds.

item.title: Kalepa raises $75M Series B at a $470M valuation for AI agents in insurance underwriting
item.description: Kalepa raised $75M at a $470M valuation for AI agents that handle insurance underwriting, and plans to double headcount by 2027.

item.title: AvePoint launches Trust Platform to govern enterprise AI agents, models and MCP servers
item.description: AvePoint launched a Trust Platform to govern enterprise AI agents, models and MCP servers, including discovery of shadow AI.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer ships a TyMetrix 360° MCP server for governed legal invoice workflows
item.description: Wolters Kluwer launched an MCP server for TyMetrix 360°, letting legal teams run invoice workflows in one AI conversation under existing permissions.

item.title: Meta moves WhatsApp marketing templates to a dedicated API; Cloud API marketing ends Oct 13, 2027
item.description: Meta is moving WhatsApp marketing messages to a dedicated API: Cloud API marketing sends stop working on October 13, 2027.

item.title: METR: Anthropic's benchmark capability progress accelerated ~1.9x since Oct 2025
item.description: Independent evaluator METR estimates Anthropic's AI capability progress accelerated about 1.9x since October 2025, with key evidence redacted.

item.description: CoinGecko cut its x402 crypto data price in half to $0.005 per call and added USDC payments on Polygon alongside Base and Solana.

item.description: Roundhouse AI added Solana to its x402 payments dashboard, which now tracks over 202 million agent payments worth $45.6 million across three blockchains.
